title: Lorentzian Kähler-Dirac fermions
summary: We examine the formulation of Kähler fermions on spacetimes with Lorentz signature. In practice we focus on Minkowski spacetime since most of the difficulties that are encountered are visible even when the spacetime is flat. We show that the theory, when interpreted as a Lorentz invariant theory of forms or antisymmetric tensor fields, is non-unitary. We show that unitarity can be restored provided one adopts a modified inner product on the Hilbert space.
